verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document an auditor role, auditor portal, or scoped auditor view of controls and evidence inside Secureframe. The Trust Center is a related but different feature: it serves prospects and customers who request documents. References to 'audit activity' in notifications and to templates approved by former auditors do not show auditors working in the platform.

support.subject: As a founder, my auditor works directly in the platform — a scoped auditor view of controls and evidence replaces email threads of PDFs
